NAME
    Get-ChildItem

SYNTAX
    Get-ChildItem [[-Path] <string>] [-Filter <string>] [-LiteralPath <string>]
    [-Depth <int32>] [-Force] [-Recurse] [-Name] [<CommonParameters>]

    Get-ChildItem [[-Path] <string>] [-Filter <string>] [-LiteralPath <string>]
    [-Include <string[]>] [-Exclude <string[]>] [-Recurse] [-Depth <int32>]
    [-Force] [-Name] [<CommonParameters>]

DESCRIPTION
    Gets the items and child items in one or more specified locations.

PARAMETERS
    -Path <string>
        Specifies a path to one or more locations.

    -Force
        Allows the cmdlet to get items that otherwise cannot be accessed.

    -Recurse <bool>
        Gets all items in specified locations and child items.
